faults.fault: At 2x width the cabinet face texture is smeared, banded and patched: large blank blue panel where the display window should extend, and the lower body shows repeated tray-shaped blocks. At 1.5x height the same repeat bands stack as three identical tray panels down the lower body. The background needs mirror tiling so joins reflect instead of cutting.

Products are 'fixed', so when the cabinet is widened the display window does not gain product columns -- the stretched window shows scattered single bags floating on blank panel and smeared shelf bands instead of new columns of product. Fails the meaning of a wider vending machine.

Fixed products leave the widened/tallened window with blank shelf runs and stray bags outside the shelf grid; no new rows or columns are generated, so the resized cabinet reads as an empty shell with decals stuck on.

Same fixed-product fault: at 2x width the bottom rows show isolated bags and long empty shelf rail, and at 1.5x height the products bunch at the top with empty shelving below -- a taller machine should show more product rows, not blank panel.
Flap has no opening motion assigned.
Flap is static instead of functional.
Scaling horizontally and vertically causes severe smearing and misaligned seams.

wider_means: a wider vending machine has more product columns across the display window
